To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
1) we can use unstructured product data to learn a set of product attributes and 2) this set of product attributes is useful for product recommendations.

(1) a combination of unsupervised and supervised machine learning techniques can be used to extract attributes from unstructured data; (2) the extracted attributes can be used to improve the quality of recommendations in a hybrid fashion; (3) the quality of the attributes can be further improved by using the recommendations as an additional source of supervision.

(1) we developed a methodology and system to automatically characterise products from unstructured data, (2) the product characterisation can be used in a hybrid recommENDER system to improve recommendation accuracy, and (3) the product characterisations can be used for forecasting and product planning.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of methods for the automatic characterisation of fashion products, and the application of these methods for the improvement of the customer experience, the demand forecasting and the product assortment optimisation.
the question of how can we learn product attributes from unstructured text data to enable better recommendations and personalisation.
how we can learn attributes from unstructured product information to better personalise recommendations and understand customer demand.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the solution to these challenges involves learning attributes from unstructured data, and then applying them to recommend fashion products.
the product characterisation methodology described in this paper is an effective and scalable solution to the challenges described, and has led to significant improvements to ASOS's business.

we have developed a methodology that enables us to learn the attributes of products, to understand the customers' preferences for these attributes, to predict demand for products, to forecast the demand of products and to recommend products to customers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show how to learn product attributes and then how to use them in the context of recommendations.

we have developed a methodology and a solution that enables us to understand the product space in terms of the attributes and attributes values, and to use this understanding to recommend products to customers.
by learning the attributes of each product from its textual descriptions and images, we are able to provide more accurate recommendations to our customers.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a detailed understanding of products can be obtained through a combination of manual and automatic methods, which can be used in a variety of applications to improve the customer experience, forecast demand and plan the product range.
by using unstructured product information, we can achieve a significant improvement over a baseline system.
the combination of a deep quantitative understanding of the product catalogue with a hybrid recommendation system can lead to a significant increase in sales.
